title: 主谓一致的判断
goal: 找出决定谓语形式的主语中心词；选择与主语一致的谓语形式。

points.label: 找出决定谓语形式的主语中心词
选择与主语一致的谓语形式

sources.title: 大学英语六级（CET-6）：课表
sources.used: 写作部分本课的内容范围、知识点与练习规格

body.p: 谓语用单数还是复数，看主语的中心词，不看离谓语最近的名词。介词短语里的复数名词不影响单数中心词。判断时先找主语中心词，再看修饰语、代词和数量短语。

body.box: The condition of the seats requires attention. The seats near the entrance require attention.

body.p: 第一句的中心词是 condition，谓语用 requires。第二句的中心词是 seats，谓语用 require。of the seats 和 near the entrance 都是修饰语。

cards.title: 主语与介词短语
rows: 单数中心
中心词是单数，of 后的复数名词不影响谓语。
The quality of the recordings varies.
复数中心
中心词是复数，介词后的单数名词不影响谓语。
The labels on the container need replacing.
附加成分
with 引出附加成分，谓语跟前面的主语一致。
The director with two assistants is present.
并列主语
and 连接两个人或物，谓语用复数。
The director and two assistants are present.

cards.title: 不定代词
rows: each
each 作主语，谓语用单数。
Each of the suggestions deserves consideration.
everyone
everyone 作主语，谓语为单数。
Everyone in the workshops has a name badge.
both
both 指双方，作主语用复数。
Both of the entrances are accessible.
代词与修饰语
of 短语只说明范围，谓语仍跟 each 用单数。
Each of the drawers contains a separate set of tools.

cards.title: 动名词主语
rows: 一项活动
动名词短语作主语，谓语一般用单数。
Comparing several versions takes time.
带复数宾语
宾语是复数，主语仍是一项活动，谓语用单数。
Keeping accurate records helps later reviewers.
主语边界
动名词后的宾语属于主语，谓语在宾语之后。
Reading the notices requires concentration.
不同活动并列
两项不同的活动用 and 并列，谓语用复数。
Packing the exhibits and arranging transport are separate tasks.

cards.title: 数量短语
rows: the number of
表示数量本身，谓语用单数。
The number of available seats is limited.
a number of
表示若干个，后接复数名词，谓语用复数。
A number of seats are reserved.
部分与整体
half of 等看 of 后的名词：不可数用单数，复数用复数。
Half of the equipment is ready. Half of the boxes are ready.
整体度量
时间、金额等看作一个总量时，谓语用单数。
Ten minutes is enough for this brief check.

body.box: The number of requests from separate departments ___ increasing. Each of the coordinators ___ a copy of the current list. Reviewing the requests ___ time, even when several coordinators share the work.

1. are / have / take
2. is / has / takes
3. is / have / take
4. are / has / takes

body.p: 答案是第二项。三处主语是 The number、Each 和 Reviewing the requests，都用单数谓语。departments、coordinators 和 requests 在修饰语或宾语的位置，不影响谓语。

body.box: A number of requests are incomplete.

body.p: a number of requests 表示若干个请求，谓语用复数。the number of 和 a number of 只差一个冠词，谓语的数相反。

items.stem: In “The arrangement of the chairs affects access,” which element controls affects?
items.why: arrangement 是主语中心词，即第一项。chairs 在 of 短语里，不影响谓语。

items.stem: In “Checking the records takes patience,” what is the complete subject?
items.why: Checking the records 是动名词短语，整个短语作主语，即第二项。records 是 Checking 的宾语。

items.stem: Choose the pair for a present-tense description: Each of the compartments ___ a label, and both of the lids ___ secure.
items.why: Each 作主语用 has，both 作主语用 are，即第三项。compartments 在 of 短语里，不影响谓语。

items.stem: Choose the pair: The number of vacant stalls ___ small, but a number of stalls ___ still available.
items.why: the number 表示数量本身，用 is。a number of stalls 表示若干个摊位，用 are。即第四项。

items.stem: Make the condition, rather than the individual folders, the subject of the main statement.
items.why: condition 是中心词，谓语用 requires。of the folders 是修饰语。

items.stem: Make the single activity of checking details the subject.
items.why: Checking the details 是一项活动，谓语用单数 requires。

items.stem: Describe everyone’s possession of a pass in the present.
items.why: everyone 作主语，谓语用单数 has。
a number of boxes 表示若干个箱子，谓语用 are。

items.stem: In “The location of the temporary signs determines whether visitors can find the rear entrance without asking a member of staff,” what controls determines?
items.why: location 是主语中心词，即第一项。signs 在 of 短语里，visitors 和 entrance 属于后面的从句。

items.stem: In “Maintaining accurate records of equipment loans requires regular attention from staff working at the desk,” what is the complete subject?
options: Maintaining accurate records of equipment loans
Regular attention from staff working at the desk
items.why: Maintaining accurate records of equipment loans 是一项活动，整个短语作主语，即第二项。第一项只取了 Maintaining 的宾语。

items.stem: Choose the present-tense pair: Everyone in the discussion groups ___ a written agenda, and each of the facilitators ___ responsible for recording unanswered questions.
items.why: Everyone 和 each 作主语都用单数，即第三项。groups 和 facilitators 在修饰语里，不影响谓语。

items.stem: Choose the present-tense pair: The number of completed applications ___ increasing, although a number of applications ___ still missing the required statement of purpose.
items.why: the number 表示数量本身，用 is。a number of applications 表示若干份申请，用 are。即第四项。

items.stem: Construct the main statement with description as the head, despite the intervening plural noun procedures.
items.tail: among staff who need to agree on a consistent approach.
items.why: description 是单数中心词，谓语用 provides。procedures 是 of 的宾语。

items.stem: Construct a statement whose subject is the activity of comparing the proposed routes.
items.tail: for visitors who cannot use the steps near the original entrance.
items.why: Comparing the proposed routes 是一项活动，谓语用单数 reveals。

items.stem: State that each individual among the reviewers has the same responsibility.
items.tail: using evidence that can be traced to the submitted material.
items.why: Each 作主语，谓语用 has。of the reviewers 只说明范围。

items.stem: Treat the proportion as a part of uncountable equipment in a present-tense statement.
items.tail: by the technician who will prepare the room for the demonstration.
items.why: equipment 不可数，Half of the equipment 用 is。
